description:
Backup Monitor & Configurator — the backup-paths automaton as a plugin.

Two halves: a CONFIG half that emits backup-configuration coherence advisories (CONF0001-0006: encryption off, physical-on-master, no off-site archive, split off, subscription-gated paths) routed to the ConfigStateMachine; and a MONITOR half that emits backup observability (BUP0001 progress bytes, BUP0002 binlog-coverage watermark, BUP0003 restorability) routed to the BackupStateMachine. Does NOT produce backups — it reads live state and advises config.

config_keys.label: Subscription plan
config_keys.help: Cloud18 subscription plan used to gate supported-only backup paths. Falls back to the injected cloud18-subscription-plan.

config_keys.label: Supported-only paths minimum plan
config_keys.help: Minimum plan at which supported-only backup paths (off-site archive, encryption, long-archived PITR, remote exec) are considered valid.

config_keys.label: Advise when backups are not encrypted
config_keys.help: Emit CONF0001 when no restic password / backup-crypt key is set.

config_keys.label: Advise when no off-site archive
config_keys.help: Emit CONF0003 when restic off-site archiving is disabled.

config_keys.label: Advise when physical backup runs on master
config_keys.help: Emit CONF0002 when a physical backup is taken on the master instead of a prefered backup slave.
